items.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.

items.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
items.summary: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.

items.title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’
items.summary: Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years. But this extended partnerships stretches beyond buying more chips.

items.title: Meta’s $18B child-safety deal hinges on age-verification tech that doesn’t work well
items.summary: The historic settlement reignites ongoing concern around how age-verification technology puts privacy at risk.

items.title: Flipboard acquires Graze, the feed builder working to monetize the open social web
items.summary: Flipboard is acquiring Bluesky feed-building startup Graze, bringing its privacy-friendly ad technology and creator monetization tools into Flipboard’s growing open social web ecosystem.

items.summary: The firm backs companies building in the “female economy,” or the markets where women drive demand — women’s health, digital commerce, and AI tools.
